'''2007 Ohio State Championship Lee Edwards DS Drop! (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Lee Edwards]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-32-Drop-remaster.webp|label=Drop! (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' My Tank is Fight
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
